observations.observation: The REA entry rises from row four through intermediate positions to row one; displaced entries redistribute and the destination row receives orange emphasis.
observations.technique: Identity-preserving state change with destination emphasis.
observations.use_when: The learner needs to track one object through a real change of status or position.
observations.avoid_when: Movement would imply a false ordering, such as ranking cached responses.

observations.observation: The retained ranking panel shifts left while a tool badge and two browser/app windows assemble on the right; window interiors subsequently become code-like lines.
observations.technique: Lateral restaging that preserves context while exposing a related view.
observations.use_when: A detail view explains an already established object's behavior.
observations.avoid_when: Keeping every panel forces teaching labels below readable size.

observations.observation: User silhouettes move from lower scattered positions into a cluster beneath one item in a choice strip; that item becomes orange.
observations.technique: Actor choreography makes a distribution visible.
observations.use_when: The distribution of many actors is the actual subject.
observations.avoid_when: One request is sufficient to teach the mechanism; extra actors would add noise.

references.limitation: Opening only, sampled ordered decoded frames through the displayed 00:08. Whole-second times are approximate; intermediate frames between screenshots were not individually inspected. The 00:05–00:06 transition is unresolved. No measured easing, smoothness, camera path, audio sync or full-film rhythm. Evidence is a written viewing log; screenshots were inspected in tool history but not retained locally.

observations.observation: A large 2023 type anchor is followed by a bright source-post image against dark ground.
observations.technique: Brief orientation anchor followed by readable evidence.
observations.use_when: A date or exact label must orient a learner before its source is introduced.
observations.avoid_when: Another isolated title card would interrupt an existing causal story.

observations.observation: Python appears left, Rust right, then an arrow, an AGI? badge and a Language choice label; earlier objects keep their positions and later frames preserve the arrangement.
observations.technique: Progressive disclosure followed by a reading hold.
observations.use_when: The relation must be understood before its qualifier is introduced.
observations.avoid_when: A relation arrow merely repeats narration; show a traveling request and resulting response when teaching causality.

observations.observation: The same source-post image visibly grows in successive frames while its text remains the main subject.
observations.technique: Slow scale change toward relevant detail.
observations.use_when: Increased scale makes the detail named in narration easier to inspect.
observations.avoid_when: A push reveals no new information or crops the teaching label.

observations.observation: After the source-post image, a diagram shows xAI, Mostly Rust and Rust; the X mark is subsequently added below.
observations.technique: Interpret source evidence through staged explanation.
observations.use_when: The next picture explains the evidence just introduced.
observations.avoid_when: Replacing the whole scene discards an object that could carry the explanation.

references.limitation: Opening only, sampled ordered decoded frames through the displayed 00:16. Whole-second times are approximate; intermediate frames between screenshots were not individually inspected. Source-to-diagram transition mechanics are unresolved. The 12–14 second image growth is visible scaling, not proof of a 3D camera. No measured curves, full-film rhythm, soundtrack review or final-phone-size legibility approval. Evidence is a written viewing log; screenshots were inspected in tool history but not retained locally.
